div.head: II Cn 4
div.ab: And we beodað, þæt man eard georne clænsian aginne on æghwylcan ende ⁊ mánfulra dæda æghwær geswice.
⁊ we beodað, þæt man eard georne clǽnsian aginne on æghwylcum énde ⁊ mánfulra dæda æghwár geswíce.
And we beodað, þæt man eard georne clænsian agynne on aghwylcan ende ⁊ manfulra dæda æghwær geswyce.
[4] And witena gerædnes is, þæt man eard georne clænsian onginne on æghwilcon ende ⁊ manfulra dæda æghwar geswice.
Et totis uiribus semper mundare patriam studeamus in omnibus finibus eius et ab inmundis operibus circumquaque cessemus.
[4] Edicimus quoque, ut patriam in finibus omnibus mundemus, et ut a sceleribus cessetur.
⁊ we beodað þæt man eard georne clǽnsian aginne on æghwylcum énde ⁊ manfulra dæda æghwár geswíce.
And we beodað þæt man eard georne clænsian aginne on æghwylcan ende and manfulra dæda æghwær geswice.
Und wir gebieten (Beschluss der Witan ist D), dass man das Land eifrig zu säubern unternehme in jeder Richtung und von lasterhaften Thaten überall abstehe.
And we command (it is the decision of the witan, D) that the land be eagerly cleansed in every part, and that wicked deeds cease everywhere.
And we enjoin that the purification of the land in every part shall be diligently undertaken, and that evil deeds shall everywhere be put an end to.
And we command that the people undertake to purify the entire land and eradicate everywhere all sinful deeds.
